author: Jeronetj3
body:
Here we see something that became new content as of the start of June. These areas are called the Rifftbreaks. There’s bunch of different ones, but they have a few things in common.

1. The area is invaded by these group of mobs. It’s a (sub) family of mobs tied to the name of the Riftbreak
2. There’s a specific quest/mission. If I’m not mistaken this mission is shared globally with other Riftbreaks where other players can pitch in on the objective. The reward is (quite) some Orns, Gold and Exp.
3. Once you’ve entered the area you should be able to add it to your overworld que to instantly go to the center of the area or go back to your geolocation
4. There’s Riftbreaks will start on the full hour and be around for one hour

In this specific area you will be encountering mimics and a lot of them!
Your goal here is to stop these mimics. Mimics are part of a mob family. The characteristics of mimics is that they imitate chests to lure ignorant adventurers to snack on. The nice thing about mimics is that when defeated they will leave you a rich assortment of gear, it can contain a lot of common stuff but also some niche gear not widely available.    

TL;DR; you’ve encountered a mimic invasion
